column1: # Route × role expectation table (NFR-02, ADR 0002). One line per mapped route of the app:
# METHOD  PATTERN  anonymous  CUSTOMER  OPERATOR  ADMIN  — expected status, "|" for alternatives.
# ANY means the mapping accepts every method (tested with GET). Path variables are replaced by
# "1" and "/**" by "/x". A mapped route missing here, or a line without a mapping, fails the test.
# auth module (ADR 0003, ADR 0004): sign-in entries, link pages and the Phase 1 stub homes.
# customers module (CUS-02, CUS-06): registration behind a REGISTER link (the controller checks the token or the session), profile.
# orders module (CUS-04, CUS-05): list, detail and wizard behind a customer session.
# site module (ADR 0012, 0013, 0014): the public pages of chapter 06 §3.1, the generated files, the form endpoint.
# POST /api/form without Origin or Referer is refused by the controller's own check (ADR 0014)
# tracking module (ADR 0010, 0011): the kept legacy endpoints and the 410 catch-all
